text:
maya: compliance again: they need a clear 'who changed routing' entry in audit exports (not just Rollouts). can we add route_policy_change events?

omar: yes. minimal inline fields + change_ref for full blob. schema: routing_policy_id, action, actor_id, change_summary, change_ref, tenant_id.

jen: keep inline tiny to save export bytes. full JSON goes into encrypted blob behind change_ref. add exposure_level and retention_policy_id.

sam: sample NDJSON row: {"event_type":"route_policy_change","routing_policy_id":"rp_42","actor_id":"u_maya","action":"update","change_summary":"shifted 10% -> pool-b","change_ref":"blob_v1:202603","exposure_level":"internal","retention_policy_id":"r_long"}

infra-bot: deploy audit-blob-service v1 -> prod :white_check_mark: 1765436820

maya: UX: show summary, exposure badge, and "download full diff" CTA that needs permissions. jen: I'll draft redaction rules for contractor PII.

omar: also include actor_hint (sha256) and actor_resolution_status. that keeps raw emails out of exports.

maya: ok team. sam please open PR with schema + tests. using this thread as design anchor.
